part: OPA2197IDR - TI PSpice macromodel (OPAx197, SBOMA34D Rev D)
notes: VERBATIM copy of OPAx197.LIB from TI's 'OPAx197 PSpice Model (Rev. D)' zip SBOMA34D (listed on https://www.ti.com/product/OPA2197), saved as .lib. Header: Model Version Final 1.3, Date 23JUN2022, Datasheet SBOS737C. .SUBCKT OPAx197 IN+ IN- VCC VEE OUT. Plain text, NOT encrypted. Runs in ngspice 42 only with `set ngbehavior=psa` in .spiceinit (without it: 'Undefined parameter [temp]', fatal); checked 2026-09-29 as a unity buffer on +/-15 V: output 23.7 uV at 0 V in, -3 dB at 17.5 MHz. The TINA-TI variant SBOMA35C was fetched and not banked (same subcircuit for another simulator). Used by tools/sim.py for U-BUF and U-OPA-PITCH.

part: TI Precision Design TIDU026 - Single Op-Amp Slew Rate Limiter (OPA197; glyph key for SBOS737C figures)
notes: GENUINE TI reference design, 10 pp, text layer extracts ('TI Precision Designs: Reference Design / Single Op-Amp Slew Rate Limiter', Tim Green). BANKED AS THE KEY TO A FONT IN THE BANKED OPA2197.pdf (SBOS737C): its schematic callouts extract with a substitution font, and SBOS737C Figure 55 - this design - reads '1.69 NŸ' and '1.6 0Ÿ' where this document prints R1 1.69k and R2 1.6M. So 'N' is k and '0' is M. APPLIED TO SBOS737C FIGURE 56 (section 8.2.3, Precision Reference Buffer, p.30): R_F is '1 NŸ' = 1 kOHM, NOT 1 Mohm, and R_Fx is '10 NŸ' = 10 kohm, C_F 39 nF, R_ISO 37.4 ohm, C_L 10 uF. Cross-check in SBOS737C's own prose: 'closed-loop signal bandwidth at VOUT of 4 kHz' = 1/(2.pi.1k.39n) = 4.08 kHz; with 1 Mohm it would be 4.08 Hz. config/figures.yaml riso-ref-topology reads R_F as 1 Mohm (found 2026-09-29, hardware/carrier/breath-excitation-reference/sim).
